# Claims to verify

Each source named below is a saved copy in this folder, at the path given; read it there. The other saved copies in sources/ may serve as independent sources.

- C1 Acme Storage's Standard tier costs $0.021 per GB-month (price list effective 1 March 2026). Source: sources/acme-price-list.md
- C2 Acme Storage includes the first 100 GB of egress each month free, then charges $0.05 per GB. Source: sources/acme-price-list.md
- C3 Hearth DB 4.2, released on 14 May 2026, raised the maximum database size to 64 TiB. Source: sources/hearth-4.2-release-notes.md
- C4 Acme Storage's chief technology officer, Dana Reyes, said: "We have no plans to charge for reads this year." Source: sources/acme-interview.md
- C5 On Acme Storage's Archive tier, writes cost $5.00 per million. Source: sources/acme-price-list.md
